summary: Unpinned github: dependency to third-party user repo enables install-time RCE
details: @xzvbailss/baileys@6.0.9 is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library whose package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or branch pin. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever currently lives at HEAD of that third-party user repository and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains on the installer's machine. The upstream Baileys project resolves `libsignal` from the npm registry; redirecting resolution to an unpinned personal GitHub account places code execution on every installer under the control of whoever holds that account, with no integrity check and no version pinning. The generics.js `ping` reference is part of the library's WhatsApp keep-alive logic and is not itself an attack indicator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
